name: Breastplate of Bloodthirst
label: Quest
description: Breastplate of Bloodthirst: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is said that only one Breastplate of Bloodthirst has ever been created and that it was made for the legendary assassin, Garona. Whether this world will ever see another is doubtful.
Regardless! Our master crafters can reproduce the item given the necessary components:

clips.title: Progress
paras: Unless you've got everything I need, you're wasting my time.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I thought I would be dead and buried before I ever saw this day.
An accomplishment of this magnitude can only be overshadowed by the reward.
